channelTitle: Puffy eyes? Grandma's tea bag trick
hook: Puffy, tired eyes after a rough night? Grandma always kept the used tea bags instead of tossing them.
remedy: Chilled, used tea bags pressed over the eyes are a classic bit of home wisdom for calming puffiness and tired-looking eyes — the cool, damp compress is the soothing part.
steps: Steep two tea bags, then let them cool in the fridge for about 15 minutes
Lie back and place one bag over each closed eye
Rest for 10 to 15 minutes, then rinse your face with cool water
caution: Make sure the tea bags aren't hot — always let them cool fully first. Skip this if you have an eye infection or irritation.
cta: Follow along for more old-school home remedies
